name: Honeydust
body:
Price 20 gp

ABOUT

The use of this mild, dizzying powder has spread throughout much of the world. Once taken, this sparkling, honeydew-colored inhalant gives the user a euphoric sensation that can quickly become overwhelming and even sickening. While the long-term effects are relatively minor, few except the hardy care to risk stomaching this toxin.

DETAILS

Type inhaled; Addiction minor, Fortitude DC 13

EFFECT

1 hour; +1d2 alchemical bonus to Charisma, –2 penalty on saves against illusions

EFFECT

After 1 hour; 75% chance to become sickened for 1d4 hours

DAMAGE

1d2 Wis damage
